topics.titleTr: Tek Kisilik Girisim Icin AI Ajan Yigini
topics.titleEn: The Solo Founder's AI Agent Stack
topics.angle: guide|A practical AI-agent stack that lets one founder run marketing, ops and support.
topics.brief: Sections: the shift (solo-founded startups hit 36.3% of new companies in 2026; most micro-SaaS earn $5k-$50k/mo with no full-time staff); the stack by function (marketing funnel, support, CI/CD, customer success) with a realistic $300-$500/mo budget; designing agents around one narrow workflow with approval rules; where humans stay in the loop; risks of over-automation. Verify: solo-founder and cost stats, agent-stack economics. Sources: mean.ceo B2B SaaS trends 2026, Forbes AI agent startups, AgentMarketCap.

topics.titleTr: Koltuk Basi Fiyat Oldu mu? Kullanima Dayali SaaS
topics.titleEn: Is Per-Seat Pricing Dead? Usage-Based SaaS
topics.angle: deep-dive|Why per-seat pricing is fading for agent-led software and how to design usage/outcome models.
topics.brief: Sections: the thesis (per-seat pricing loses appeal when agents, not seats, do the work); the emerging mix (platform fee + usage-based billing + outcome-linked charges); the hard constraint (customers must predict and explain the bill to finance); worked pricing examples and margin math; migration from seats without churn; risks (bill shock, gaming metered usage). Verify: pricing-trend claims, outcome-pricing patterns. Sources: Journeybee SaaS 2026 trends, mean.ceo B2B SaaS edition.

topics.angle: checklist|A vetted checklist of AI-era micro-SaaS niches and how to validate one fast.
topics.brief: Sections: why micro-SaaS now (tiny teams, AI agents, 60-80% margins); a checklist of promising 2026 niches (vertical AI agents, compliance/ops automation, creator tooling, GEO/AEO tooling, data-cleanup utilities) with why each has demand; a fast validation loop (search demand, willingness to pay, wedge feature); pricing and moat notes; niches to avoid (crowded, no wedge). Verify: niche demand signals, micro-SaaS economics. Sources: Superframeworks top AI SaaS niches 2026, IdeaProof, mean.ceo trends.

topics.titleTr: AI Caginda Bootstrap mi, Yatirim mi?
topics.titleEn: Bootstrap or Raise in the AI Agent Era?
topics.angle: comparison|Compare bootstrapping and raising when AI agents slash the cost of building.
topics.brief: Sections: the setup (AI agent stacks cut a founder's cost base 95-98%, changing the raise-or-bootstrap math); a comparison (speed, control, dilution, risk, ceiling) when tiny teams can reach real revenue alone; when VC still makes sense (winner-take-most markets, heavy GTM); a decision framework; the contrarian point that 'default to raise' is often wrong now. Verify: cost-reduction stats, one-person-company revenue examples. Sources: Forbes solo-founder playbook 2026, GreyJournal $1M solo founders, mean.ceo.

topics.titleTr: Claude Yasam Bilimleri Dogrulama Programi Nedir?
topics.angle: deep-dive|Explain Anthropic's Life Sciences Verification Program and why it matters for AI in science.
topics.brief: Sections: the context (Anthropic launched a Life Sciences Verification Program, Sept 17 2026, amid Claude's scientific work like a novel enzyme-system discovery); what the program verifies and who it's for (researchers, labs, biotech); how verification balances access with dual-use safety in a sensitive domain; what it signals about AI-for-science guardrails; practical takeaways for teams evaluating AI in regulated research. Verify: program scope, eligibility, launch date. Sources: anthropic.com/news Sept 2026, Anthropic safety posts.

topics.titleTr: Cihazda mi Bulutta mi? Yapay Zekanin Yeri
topics.titleEn: On-Device vs Cloud AI: Where Should It Run?
topics.angle: comparison|Compare on-device and cloud AI on privacy, cost, latency and capability.
topics.brief: Sections: the question (should this AI feature run on my device or in the cloud?); what's driving on-device AI in 2026 (privacy-conscious design, local processing in phones and smart homes, offline use); a comparison across privacy, latency, cost, model capability and battery; hybrid patterns (local first, cloud for heavy tasks); how to choose for a product or personal setup. Verify: 2026 on-device AI trends, hybrid architectures. Sources: CES 2026 coverage, Android on-device AI reports, vendor docs.
